82.打印菱形
 
83.expect实现远程登陆自动交互
 
declare -a ary
for s in `seq 1 10000`
do
    for i in `seq 40 49`
    do
        ary[$i]=" "
        echo -en "\e[$i;5m ${ary[@]}\e[;0m"    
    done
done
#!/bin/bash
for (( i = 1; i < 12; i++))
do
    if [[ $i -le 6 ]]
    then
        for ((j = $((12-i)); j > i; j--))
        do
            echo -n " "
        done
        for ((m = 1; m <= $((2*i-1)); m++))
        do
             echo -n "* "
        done
            echo ""
#*****************************************************************************
    elif [[ $i -gt 6 ]]
    then
        n=$((12-i))
        for ((j = $((12-n)); j > n; j--))
        do
            echo -n " "
        done
        for ((m = 1; m <= $((2*n-1)); m++))
        do
                        echo -n "* "
        done
            echo ""
    fi
done
#!/usr/bin/expect -f
set ipaddress [lindex $argv 0]
set passwd [lindex $argv 1]
